messages:
anya_cs: Quick alert 1 Ironforge Logistics wants a compact multimodal parser (target ~7B) for on-prem. Needs OCR from phone photos, manifest parsing, PII redaction at edge, hazmat detection, and HSM/KMS integration. They want an eval and rollout proposal ahead of renewal (~6w). Can ENG/SE triage?

todd_runtime: Got it. Two quick asks: what p95 latency SLO for text and OCR? and what GPUs do they have on-prem? q4 quant likely but need infra to confirm.

janet_se: I'll send the intake checklist and request 200 sample manifests + 100 photos. Drafting an enablement deck and runbook.

anya_cs: Must-haves from customer: hazmat recall >= 0.95, PII must be redacted before leaving their network, audit logs retained 90d. If we miss the eval window, AE flagged renewal risk.

todd_runtime: For HSM we'll need their PKCS#11 endpoint + test creds. Proposal: rwd-7b-q4 for low-latency route, and rwd-7b-q2 for cost-savings fallback. Expect text p95 <120ms, OCR up to 600ms.

janet_se: Eval plan: 5k labeled examples, metrics: entity F1, hazmat recall, redaction success, p95. Canary: 10% traffic 7d; rollback if hazmat recall <0.93 or any PII leakage. I'll own harness + dashboard. Example command:

python eval_harness.py --model rwd-7b-q4 --data ironforge_samples.jsonl --metrics recall,precision,f1,latency --out report.json

ops_bot: Checklist created: [intake_sent] [samples_requested] [hsm_details_requested] [eval_assigned] [canary_planned]
